# LR 2026-11-19 (user): the Philoi, the Friends of the King, the Kosmokrator's five offices as court positions (never
# council seats: see the Principate crash, LR_principate_court_positions.txt). Aptitude = skill + merit level; any culture
# of the realm may serve (fusion policy: a non-Greek Philos raises acceptance yearly, LR_kosmokratoria_on_actions.txt).
# Generated by tools/kosmokratoria/write_kosmokratoria_files.py; edit there and re-run.

LR_chiliarchos_court_position = {
	sort_order = 520
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = empire
	skill = martial

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = reading
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/throneroom_mediterranean.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = 20
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = martial
			multiply = 1.75
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_martial
		}
		# The King's Friends rise by merit
		add = {
			value = merit_level
			multiply = 5
			max = 25
			desc = court_position_merit_level
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = strategist }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_strategist_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = brave }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = court_position_brave_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = wrathful }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = court_position_wrathful_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = craven }
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = court_position_craven_trait
			}
		}
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root is the court owner
	is_shown = {
		LR_kosmokratoria_office_shown_trigger = yes
	}

	valid_position = {
		LR_kosmokratoria_office_shown_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	# Fusion policy: a Philos may be of any culture of the realm
	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			LR_kosmokratoria_office_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = LR_chiliarchos_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = major_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = LR_chiliarchos } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		treasury_or_gold = {
			value = major_court_position_salary
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = major_court_position_salary
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			direct_vassal_opinion = 2
			men_at_arms_maintenance = -0.02
		}
		poor = {
			direct_vassal_opinion = 4
			men_at_arms_maintenance = -0.04
		}
		average = {
			direct_vassal_opinion = 6
			men_at_arms_maintenance = -0.06
		}
		good = {
			direct_vassal_opinion = 8
			men_at_arms_maintenance = -0.08
		}
		excellent = {
			direct_vassal_opinion = 10
			men_at_arms_maintenance = -0.1
		}
	}

	# A Friend of the King earns merit and renown
	modifier = {
		monthly_merit = 1
		monthly_prestige = 0.5
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}

	ai_position_score = {
		value = 150
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 100
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}

		}

				value = 10

		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = craven }

				value = -15

	}

	# Fusion policy: a Philos may be of any culture of the realm
	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			LR_kosmokratoria_office_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = LR_somatophylax_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = major_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = LR_somatophylax } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {

			value = medium_court_position_salary
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = medium_court_position_salary
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			enemy_hostile_scheme_success_chance_add = -2
			knight_effectiveness_mult = 0.02
		}
		poor = {
			enemy_hostile_scheme_success_chance_add = -4
			knight_effectiveness_mult = 0.04
		}
		average = {
			enemy_hostile_scheme_success_chance_add = -6
			knight_effectiveness_mult = 0.06
		}
		good = {
			enemy_hostile_scheme_success_chance_add = -8
			knight_effectiveness_mult = 0.08
		}
		excellent = {
			enemy_hostile_scheme_success_chance_add = -10
			knight_effectiveness_mult = 0.1
		}
	}

	# A Friend of the King earns merit and renown
	modifier = {
		monthly_merit = 1
		monthly_prestige = 0.5
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
